headline: Brown holds Clemson scoreless on the road
dek: Brown held Clemson without a goal, extending a defensive streak that began with shutouts at Dartmouth and Columbia. The draw leaves Brown at twelve wins, three draws and four losses overall — more wins than any other Ivy program — with 41 goals scored and seventeen conceded across all matches.
displaced_by: Brown drew at Clemson, and Harvard now shares Brown's 41-goal lead across all matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring volume has not tracked the Ivy table: Harvard reached 41 goals with at least twelve different scorers, led by Brooke Huleatt with eleven, yet finished below Dartmouth and Columbia.

wire.line: Harvard freshman Brooke Huleatt has eleven goals and seven assists as Harvard matches Brown's 41-goal total.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dartmouth's match against Assumption is past its date with no published result, the only Ivy match in that state.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ola Goebel has kept ten shutouts in goal for Dartmouth.

findings.text: Dartmouth has conceded ten goals across all its matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Yale has scored 23 goals, more than Columbia, Cornell or Penn. It has also lost ten of its matches.

last_match.line: Brown arrived having beaten both Dartmouth and Columbia away without conceding.
